lastCompletedStory.title: Real-tmux integration test: verdict line lands in orchestrator pane via the wired closure

nextStoryContext: US-003 added a real-tmux integration test proving the end-to-end verdict handback: makeNotifyOrchestrator closure sends CLEAN/FIXES_PENDING/MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT verdict lines to the orchestrator pane and they appear in capture-pane output. Pattern follows tmux-introspect.test.ts: socket-swap SpawnFn isolates tests from live cam sessions. US-004 is the next story (structured supervisor event for verdict handback in cam-worker-events.jsonl).
